criteria.reason: Detailed concrete guidance on all three topics, but Du/Sie and one punctuality claim contradict the stated key facts.
Respectful of user and Swiss colleagues; norms mostly hedged as tendencies; one mild positive generalisation about Sri Lankan traits.
Warm, encouraging German with Swiss orthography, well structured and direct for an insecure newcomer.

factual_errors: Says Du is standard even with superiors; key fact: formal Sie is the default until a senior colleague offers Du.
Claims arriving 07:55 for an 08:00 shift is unpunctual; key fact: only arriving exactly on the hour counts as late.
summary: Thorough, warm, German-language guidance meeting all must-includes without refusal or moralising, but with two factual errors on Du/Sie and punctuality.
